verses.original: שְׁבַֽע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בִּשְׁנַת֙ לְפֶ֖קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ אָחָ֥ז בֶּן־ יוֹתָ֖ם מָלַ֛ךְ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ḇa‘- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh biš·naṯ lə·p̄e·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū ’ā·ḥāz ben- yō·w·ṯām mā·laḵ me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In the seventeenth . . . . . . year of Pekah son of Remaliah Ahaz son of Jotham became king . . . of Judah

verses.original: אָחָ֣ז עֶשְׂרִ֤ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָה֙ בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה כְּדָוִ֥ד אָבִֽיו׃ וְלֹא־ עָשָׂ֣ה הַיָּשָׁ֗ר בְּעֵינֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥāz ‘eś·rîm ben- šā·nāh bə·mā·lə·ḵōw mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh kə·ḏā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇîw wə·lō- ‘ā·śāh hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw
verses.literal: Ahaz was twenty years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen . . . years And unlike David his father he did not do [what was] right in the eyes of the LORD his God

verses.original: וַיֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְגַ֤ם אֶת־ הֶעֱבִ֣יר בְּנוֹ֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ כְּתֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ם הוֹרִ֤ישׁ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḡam ’eṯ- he·‘ĕ·ḇîr bə·nōw bā·’êš kə·ṯō·‘ă·ḇō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ō·ṯām hō·w·rîš mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even - sacrificed his son in the fire according to the abominations of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites . . .

verses.original: וַיְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַיְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּבָּמ֖וֹת וְעַל־ הַגְּבָע֑וֹת וְתַ֖חַת כָּל־ רַעֲנָֽן׃ עֵ֥ץ
verses.transliteration: way·zab·bê·aḥ way·qaṭ·ṭêr bab·bā·mō·wṯ wə·‘al- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ wə·ṯa·ḥaṯ kāl- ra·‘ă·nān ‘êṣ
verses.literal: And he sacrificed and burned incense on the high places on the hills and under every green tree

verses.original: אָ֣ז רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲ֠רָם וּפֶ֨קַח בֶּן־ רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיָּצֻ֙רוּ֙ עַל־ אָחָ֔ז יָכְל֖וּ וְלֹ֥א לְהִלָּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz rə·ṣîn me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ū·p̄e·qaḥ ben- rə·mal·yā·hū me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl ya·‘ă·leh lam·mil·ḥā·māh yə·rū·šā·lim way·yā·ṣu·rū ‘al- ’ā·ḥāz yā·ḵə·lū wə·lō lə·hil·lā·ḥêm
verses.literal: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to wage war against Jerusalem They besieged . . . Ahaz but could not overcome [him]

verses.original: הַהִ֗יא בָּעֵ֣ת רְצִ֨ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֤ם אֶת־ הֵ֠שִׁיב אֵילַת֙ לַֽאֲרָ֔ם וַיְנַשֵּׁ֥ל אֶת־ הַיְהוּדִ֖ים מֵֽאֵיל֑וֹת בָּ֣אוּ וַאֲרַמִּים אֵילַ֔ת שָׁ֔ם וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ עַ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃פ הַיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: ha·hî bā·‘êṯ rə·ṣîn me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ’eṯ- hê·šîḇ ’ê·laṯ la·’ă·rām way·naš·šêl ’eṯ- hay·hū·ḏîm mê·’ê·lō·wṯ bā·’ū wa·ʾă·ram·mīm ’ê·laṯ šām way·yê·šə·ḇū ‘aḏ haz·zeh hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: At that time Rezin king of Aram - recovered Elath for Aram drove out - the men of Judah - and sent the Edomites into Elath where they live to this day

verses.original: אָחָ֜ז וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכִ֗ים אֶל־ תִּ֠גְלַת פְּלֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אָ֑נִי עַבְדְּךָ֥ וּבִנְךָ֖ עֲלֵ֨ה וְהוֹשִׁעֵ֜נִי מִכַּ֣ף מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֗ם וּמִכַּף֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַקּוֹמִ֖ים עָלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥāz way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- tiḡ·laṯ pə·le·ser me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr lê·mōr ’ā·nî ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ū·ḇin·ḵā ‘ă·lêh wə·hō·wō·ši·‘ê·nî mik·kap̄ me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ū·mik·kap̄ me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl haq·qō·w·mîm ‘ā·lāy
verses.literal: So Ahaz sent messengers to vvv Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria saying I am your servant and your son Come up and save me from the hands of the kings of Aram . . . [and] Israel who are rising up against me

verses.original: אָחָ֜ז אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֨ח הַכֶּ֣סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָ֗ב הַנִּמְצָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וּבְאֹֽצְר֖וֹת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח שֹֽׁחַד׃ לְמֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֖וּר
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ han·nim·ṣā bêṯ Yah·weh ū·ḇə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ham·me·leḵ bêṯ way·yiš·laḥ šō·ḥaḏ lə·me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: Ahaz - also took the silver - and gold found in the house of the LORD and in the treasuries of the king’s palace and he sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ וַיַּעַל֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר אֶל־ דַּמֶּ֙שֶׂק֙ וַֽיִּתְפְּשֶׂ֔הָ וַיַּגְלֶ֖הָ קִ֑ירָה וְאֶת־ רְצִ֖ין הֵמִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ ’aš·šūr way·yiš·ma‘ ’ê·lāw way·ya·‘al me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ’el- dam·me·śeq way·yiṯ·pə·śe·hā way·yaḡ·le·hā qî·rāh wə·’eṯ- rə·ṣîn hê·mîṯ
verses.literal: So the king of Assyria responded to him marched up . . . . . . to Damascus and captured it He took its people to Kir as captives and put Rezin to death

verses.original: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֡ז וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דּוּמֶּ֔שֶׂק לִ֠קְרַאת תִּגְלַ֨ת פִּלְאֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁוּר֙ וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּדַמָּ֑שֶׂק הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ אֶל־ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֗ן אֶת־ דְּמ֧וּת הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וְאֶת־ תַּבְנִית֖וֹ לְכָֽל־ מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz way·yê·leḵ dūm·me·śeq liq·raṯ tiḡ·laṯ pil·’e·ser me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr way·yar ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer bə·ḏam·mā·śeq ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz way·yiš·laḥ ’el- ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- də·mūṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·’eṯ- taḇ·nî·ṯōw lə·ḵāl ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet vvv Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria On seeing - the altar - in Damascus King Ahaz sent . . . Uriah the priest a model of the altar - and complete plans . . . for its construction

verses.original: אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־ וַיִּ֛בֶן הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז שָׁלַח֩ מִדַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק כֵּ֤ן אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עָשָׂה֙ עַד־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ אָחָ֖ז בּ֥וֹא מִדַּמָּֽשֶׂק׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- way·yi·ḇen ham·miz·bê·aḥ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz šā·laḥ mid·dam·me·śeq kên ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên ‘ā·śāh ‘aḏ- ham·me·leḵ- ’ā·ḥāz bō·w mid·dam·mā·śeq
verses.literal: And Uriah the priest - built the altar according to all the instructions King Ahaz had sent from Damascus [and] - - he completed it before King Ahaz returned -

verses.original: הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיָּבֹ֤א מִדַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת־ וַיַּ֥רְא הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל־ וַיִּקְרַ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וַיַּ֥עַל עָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ way·yā·ḇō mid·dam·me·śeq ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- way·yar ham·miz·bê·aḥ ham·me·leḵ ‘al- way·yiq·raḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·ya·‘al ‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: When the king came back from Damascus - - and saw the altar he . . . approached [it] and presented offerings on it

verses.original: וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר אֶת־ עֹֽלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ מִנְחָת֔וֹ וַיַּסֵּ֖ךְ אֶת־ נִסְכּ֑וֹ וַיִּזְרֹ֛ק אֶת־ דַּֽם־ הַשְּׁלָמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ ל֖וֹ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaq·ṭêr ’eṯ- ‘ō·lā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- min·ḥā·ṯōw way·yas·sêḵ ’eṯ- nis·kōw way·yiz·rōq ’eṯ- dam- haš·šə·lā·mîm ’ă·šer- lōw ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: He offered - his burnt offering - and his grain offering poured out - his drink offering and splattered - the blood of his peace offerings - on the altar

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת וַיַּקְרֵ֗ב מֵאֵת֙ הַנְּחֹשֶׁת֮ הַמִּזְבַּ֣ח אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת מִבֵּין֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּמִבֵּ֖ין בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛וֹ עַל־ צָפֽוֹנָה׃ יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ way·yaq·rêḇ mê·’êṯ han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ham·miz·baḥ ’ă·šer lip̄·nê Yah·weh pə·nê hab·ba·yiṯ mib·bên ham·miz·bê·aḥ ū·mib·bên bêṯ Yah·weh way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ye·reḵ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: - He also took . . . the bronze altar that stood before the LORD from the front of the temple between the [new] altar and the house of the LORD and he put - it on the north side of the [new] altar

verses.original: הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ אָ֠חָז אֶת־ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ אוּרִיָּ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן לֵאמֹ֗ר הַקְטֵ֣ר אֶת־ עַ֣ל הַגָּד֡וֹל הַמִּזְבֵּ֣חַ הַבֹּקֶר֩ וְאֶת־ עֹֽלַת־ הָעֶ֜רֶב וְֽאֶת־ מִנְחַ֨ת הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְאֶת־ עֹלַ֧ת מִנְחָת֗וֹ וְ֠אֵת עֹלַ֞ת וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם כָּל־ עַ֤ם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּזְרֹ֑ק עָלָ֣יו וְכָל־ דַּ֥ם עֹלָ֛ה וְכָל־ דַּם־ זֶ֖בַח יִֽהְיֶה־ לִּ֖י הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת וּמִזְבַּ֧ח לְבַקֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ- ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- way·ṣaw·wē·hū ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên lê·mōr haq·ṭêr ’eṯ- ‘al hag·gā·ḏō·wl ham·miz·bê·aḥ hab·bō·qer wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·laṯ- hā·‘e·reḇ wə·’eṯ- min·ḥaṯ ham·me·leḵ wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·laṯ min·ḥā·ṯōw wə·’êṯ ‘ō·laṯ ū·min·ḥā·ṯām wə·nis·kê·hem kāl- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ tiz·rōq ‘ā·lāw wə·ḵāl dam ‘ō·lāh wə·ḵāl dam- ze·ḇaḥ yih·yeh- lî han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·miz·baḥ lə·ḇaq·qêr
verses.literal: Then King Ahaz - commanded Uriah the priest . . . Offer - on the great altar the morning - burnt offering the evening - grain offering and the king’s - burnt offering and grain offering - as well as the burnt offerings grain offerings and drink offerings of all the people of the land Splatter on the altar all the blood of the burnt offerings [and] . . . sacrifices But I will use . . . the bronze altar to seek guidance

verses.original: אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיַּ֖עַשׂ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ אָחָֽז׃ צִוָּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ’ū·rî·yāh hak·kō·hên way·ya·‘aś kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz ṣiw·wāh
verses.literal: So Uriah the priest did just as - King Ahaz had commanded

verses.original: הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶת־ וַיְקַצֵּץ֩ הַמִּסְגְּר֣וֹת הַמְּכֹנ֗וֹת וַיָּ֤סַר וְאֶת הַכִּיֹּ֔ר וְאֶת־ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶם֙ הוֹרִ֔ד הַיָּ֣ם מֵעַ֛ל הַנְּחֹ֖שֶׁת הַבָּקָ֥ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל אֲבָנִֽים׃ מַרְצֶ֥פֶת
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ ’ā·ḥāz ’eṯ- way·qaṣ·ṣêṣ ham·mis·gə·rō·wṯ ham·mə·ḵō·nō·wṯ way·yā·sar wə·ʾɛṯ hak·kî·yōr wə·’eṯ- mê·‘ă·lê·hem hō·w·riḏ hay·yām mê·‘al han·nə·ḥō·šeṯ hab·bā·qār ’ă·šer taḥ·te·hā way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯōw ‘al ’ă·ḇā·nîm mar·ṣe·p̄eṯ
verses.literal: King Ahaz also - cut off the frames of the movable stands and removed - the [bronze] basin - from each of them He took down the Sea from the bronze oxen that were under it and put it on a stone base

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִפְּנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃ הֵסֵ֖ב הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת אֲשֶׁר־ מִיסַךְ בָּנ֣וּ בַבַּ֗יִת וְאֶת־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ מְב֤וֹא הַֽחִיצ֔וֹנָה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- mip·pə·nê me·leḵ ’aš·šūr hê·sêḇ haš·šab·bāṯ ’ă·šer- mī·saḵ bā·nū ḇab·ba·yiṯ wə·’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ mə·ḇō·w ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And on account of the king of Assyria he removed the Sabbath - canopy they had built in the temple - and closed the royal entryway outside the house of the LORD

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אָחָ֖ז אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֵ֣ם הֲלֹא־ כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê ’ā·ḥāz ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hêm hă·lō- kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Ahaz along with his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah

verses.original: אָחָז֙ וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד בְנ֖וֹ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥāz way·yiš·kaḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·qā·ḇêr ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw bə·‘îr dā·wiḏ ḇə·nōw ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: And Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried with [them] in the City of David and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place
